findings.observed: /static/img/banner-en.png ("Financing that fits your plans / Competitive rates. Clear terms. No surprises.")
findings.expected: Serve a French banner image (e.g. banner-fr.png) with translated text.
findings.description: The French page uses the English banner image, which contains English text; the French alt text describes it as French content.
Footer is left in English on the French page (also brand name differs from header "Banque Northstar").
Uses informal "tu" while the title on the same page uses "vous".
"Appliquer pour" is an anglicism; Quebec French uses "faire une demande de prêt" / "Demander un prêt".
Empty full-name validation error is in English on the French form; other fields show the French message.

findings.observed: Merci. Votre demande pour {montant} a été reçue.
findings.expected: Merci. Votre demande pour 12 500,00 $ a été reçue.
findings.description: The template variable {montant} is shown literally instead of the amount (the variable name was translated).
"Balance" is an anglicism/wrong word for an account balance; French uses "solde".
"Statement" in the banking sense is a "relevé"; "déclaration" suggests a tax/formal declaration.
In French, zero takes the singular (0 prêt actif); the plural is used here.
Section heading left in English on the French dashboard.
Transaction dates use US MM/DD/YYYY, ambiguous and not fr-CA (09/12/2026, 09/08/2026 too). The due date "2026-10-01" is also unlocalized, whereas the confirmation page uses "16 septembre 2026".
"Estimer un nouveau prêt" on the French dashboard links to the English calculator.
Label says "Pay now" while the English is "Pay later" and the help text describes a deferred first payment; meaning is reversed.

findings.expected: Taux variable de 5,2 %, sous réserve de l'approbation du crédit.
findings.description: The French drops the condition "subject to credit approval".

findings.observed: Aucune accusation pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais ne s'appliquent en cas de remboursement anticipé.
findings.description: "charges" (fees) was translated as "accusation" (legal accusation), which is wrong in context.
Monthly payment uses English currency format on the French page.
"Close" was translated as the adjective "Proche" (near) instead of the verb "Fermer".

findings.expected: Use a French image saying "Taux variable : 5,2 %".
findings.description: The French promo image states a fixed rate of 4.9%, contradicting the English image, the alt text and the page rate (variable, 5.2%).
Label uses "e-mail" while the validation message says "adresse courriel"; Quebec usage is "courriel", and terms should be consistent.

findings.observed: Not Found — The requested URL was not found on the server. If you entered the URL manually please check your spelling and try again.
findings.expected: A localized 404 page in French with site header.
findings.description: The 404 page under /fr/ is the default English server error page without site layout.
